title: InstructionCoverageAudit — one pre-start coverage judgment (sole owner: instruction auditor)
description: Exactly one audit of raw-instruction → instruction-unit → obligation completeness before START (V3-D7). Closed result COVERED | SPEC_GAP; no repair loop exists (a repair_round or fix field is rejected). SPEC_GAP requires a new WorkSpec revision and a new user START decision. The user is the trust terminal for this preflight result — v3 never claims mathematical enumeration of every semantic implication.

work_spec_ref.description: Digest-pinned WorkSpec whose unit/obligation map was judged (invariant 1).

instruction_ref.description: The exact frozen raw instruction the map was checked against.

audited_by.description: Distinguishable instruction-auditor context — never the executor of the same run (V3-D7).
